title: 第7章  一万灵石一次
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
“青霜师妹，这不太好吧。”
叶长天一脸为难。
杂役弟子的居住条件极差，就一个不到二十平米的房子，房间里也只有一张床。
月青霜竟然要跟他住一起！
这女人到底想干什么？
“长天师兄，咱们都是修行之人，就不要在乎这些繁文缛节了。”
“三千灵石是你刚才帮我的报酬，剩下两千灵石就当我跟你住一起的住宿费了，你觉得怎么样？”
月青霜玉手一挥，豪气干云地掏出了五千灵石。
叶长天看着月青霜手中的灵石，眼神瞬间亮了起来。
“青霜师妹，让你这么破费怎么好意思呢。”
叶长天嘴上说着不好意思，可收灵石的动作却是快得一批。
收好灵石，叶长天连忙替月青霜
“青霜师妹，快快请进。”
“以后师兄的房间就是你的房间，你想住怎么住都行。”
虽然直觉告诉他，月青霜这女人恐怕并不简单，找上他应该有着不可告人的目的，但他现在最缺的就是灵石。
这女人妥妥的大富婆一枚，简直就是绝佳的提款机。
看在灵石的份上，叶长天也懒得计较了。
即便月青霜真的馋他的身子，那也不是不行！
有灵石拿还能有个双修对象。
反正怎么都不亏！

“青霜师妹，这是太玄宗杂役弟子手册，你先熟悉一下，有什么不明白的地方再问我。”
叶长天拿出一本小册子递给月青霜，然后在一旁闭目打坐起来。
将月青霜给的五千灵石收入阴阳造化界后，阴阳造化界又凝聚出了一缕阴阳之力。
叶长天暂时不准备用阴阳之力继续修复玄灵宝珠。
他要用这一缕阴阳之力来提升修为！
以他对宋浩的了解，那家伙在他手中吃了大亏，绝对不会就此善罢甘休，让他顺利晋升外门弟子的。
一个炼气三层的宋浩，叶长天倒是不惧。
可宋浩的背后，还有一位炼气九层的杂役峰长老。
必须尽快提升实力才行！
叶长天意念一动，操控着那一缕阴阳之力融入身体，然后运转阴阳造化诀。
霎那间——
阴阳之力化作一股刚柔并齐的精纯能量，瞬间在叶长天四肢百骸扩散开来，不断强化着叶长天的身体，壮大着叶长天的经脉。
而叶长天的修为，也在这一刻开始飞速飙升。
炼气五层！
炼气六层！
炼气七层！
这五千灵石凝聚的阴阳之力，瞬间就让他提升了三个小境界！
“好逆天的阴阳之力！”
感受着自己暴涨的修为，叶长天心中也是惊叹不已。
他天赋奇差，乃是如同废物一般的伪灵根。

哪怕夜以继日吸收灵石修炼，修为提升速度几乎也跟蜗牛没什么分别。
可阴阳造化界凝聚的阴阳之力，与他修炼的阴阳造化诀完美契合，即便他只是伪灵根的废物，也能瞬间吸收转化为自身修为。
也就是说。
以后他只需用灵石在阴阳造化界凝聚阴阳之力，修为就能不断提升！
都特么有挂了谁还努力修炼？
搞钱氪金才是王道！
而在叶长天用阴阳之力提升实力的时候，月青霜自然也是感受到了叶长天身上的变化，美眸中不由掠过了一抹惊愕的神色。
这家伙不是天赋奇差的伪灵根吗？
他究竟干了什么，修为竟然瞬间从炼气四层暴涨到了炼气七层？
瞬间提升三个小境界！
就算拥有天灵根的她，也根本不可能做到啊。
怪不得师尊告诉她，与这家伙双修能够让她重回巅峰。
这家伙身上果然有大秘密呢。
只是——
她要如何才能与叶长天顺利完成双修呢？
总不能直接用强吧？
可双修不是单纯的那个就行，叶长天要是不愿意配合，她就算用强也没效果啊。
“要不先下点药，然后再勾引勾引？”
月青霜暗自嘀咕了一句。
先搞点药激发叶长天的欲望，她就不信凭自己的长相身材，叶长天真能忍得住！

“青霜师妹，你刚才说什么？”
就在这时，叶长天也是睁开了眼睛，目光朝着月青霜望了过来。
“没……没什么。”
月青霜吓了一跳，连忙摇头道。
叶长天盯着月青霜看了好一会儿，这才缓缓开口道：“青霜师妹，我知道你应该绝非新来的杂役弟子那么简单，说说吧，你接近我的目的究竟是什么？”
“我说我是来找你双修的，你信吗？”
月青霜眨了眨灵动的大眼睛。
“？？？”
叶长天顿时瞪大了眼睛，一脸不可置信地望着月青霜。
看来他的感觉得没错。
这女人真是来馋他身子的？
“自我介绍一下，我叫月青霜，太玄宗曾经的圣女，是师尊让我来杂役峰找你的。”
月青霜没有隐瞒，直接说出了自己的身份。
“你……你就是那位传说中的天月圣女？”
叶长天一脸震惊地看着月青霜。
天月圣女！
太玄宗有史以来第一位拥有天灵根的绝世天才，也是太玄宗史上最年轻的金丹境！
可惜——
这位天月圣女却因为一次意外，根基被毁修为尽失，从此在太玄宗销声匿迹。
如今这位天月圣女竟然出现在了他的面前。

而且还是来找他双修的！
难道是夏秋水试过他的阴阳造化诀后，觉得阴阳造化诀可以助月青霜修复根基，所以才让月青霜来找他的？
“天月圣女，我恐怕也未必有那个能力让你恢复的。”
叶长天回过神来，摇了摇头道。
“师尊说你行，你就行。”
月青霜瞥了叶长天一眼：“怎么，你不愿意？”
“这倒不是。”
叶长天苦笑了一声。
我特么不久前才跟你师尊双修了，现在要是又跟你双修，这以后岂不是辈分都乱套了？
“啪！”
月青霜也没有废话，直接将一万灵石甩到了叶长天的面前。
“一万灵石一次，干还是不干！”
“干干干！”
叶长天连连点头。
干一次就有一万灵石！
他就算跟什么过去，那也不能跟灵石过不去啊。
收好灵石，叶长天迅速在床榻上躺好了。
“圣女大人，我准备好了，你来吧。”
content_en:
"Junior Sister Qingshuang, this is not good."
Ye Changtian looked embarrassed.
The living conditions of the handyman disciples are extremely poor. They only have a house of less than 20 square meters, and there is only one bed in the room.
Yue Qingshuang actually wants to live with him!
What on earth does this woman want to do?
"Senior Brother Changtian, we are all practitioners, so we don't need to care about these red tapes."
"Three thousand spirit stones are the reward for helping me just now. The remaining two thousand spirit stones will be used as my accommodation fee to live with you. What do you think?"
Yue Qingshuang jade waved her hand and took out five thousand spirit stones with great courage.
Ye Changtian looked at the spirit stone in Yue Qingshuang's hand, and his eyes lit up instantly.
"Junior sister Qingshuang, why are you embarrassed to ask you to spend so much money?"
Ye Changtian said he was embarrassed, but he collected the spirit stones very quickly.
After putting the spirit stone away, Ye Changtian quickly replaced Yue Qingshuang.
"Junior Sister Qingshuang, please come in quickly."
"From now on, senior brother's room will be your room. You can live in it wherever you want."
Although his intuition told him that Yue Qingshuang, a woman, was probably not a simple woman and that she had an ulterior motive in finding him, what he lacked most now was spiritual stones.
This woman is truly a wealthy woman and is simply an excellent cash machine.
For the sake of the spirit stone, Ye Changtian didn't bother to worry about it.
Even if Yue Qingshuang really covets his body, that's not impossible!
If you have a spiritual stone, you can also have a partner for dual cultivation.
It’s not a loss anyway!
"Junior Sister Qingshuang, this is the handbook for Taixuan Sect's handyman disciples. You should familiarize yourself with it first and ask me if there is anything you don't understand."
Ye Changtian took out a booklet and handed it to Yue Qingshuang, then closed his eyes and sat up to meditate.
After collecting the five thousand spirit stones given by Yue Qingshuang into the Yin-Yang Creation Realm, the Yin-Yang Creation Realm condensed another ray of Yin-Yang power.
Ye Changtian is not ready to use the power of yin and yang to continue repairing the Xuanling Orb for the time being.
He wants to use this ray of yin and yang power to improve his cultivation!
Based on his understanding of Song Hao, that guy suffered a big loss at his hands and would never give up and allow him to be successfully promoted to an outer disciple.
Ye Changtian was not afraid of Song Hao who was at the third level of Qi refining.
But behind Song Hao, there was an elder from the ninth level of Qi Refining, the handyman peak.
We must improve our strength as soon as possible!
With a thought, Ye Changtian controlled the ray of yin and yang power to integrate into his body, and then operated the yin and yang creation technique.
All of a sudden——
The power of yin and yang turned into a pure energy of both hardness and softness, which instantly spread throughout Ye Changtian's limbs and bones, continuously strengthening Ye Changtian's body and expanding Ye Changtian's meridians.
And Ye Changtian's cultivation also began to soar rapidly at this moment.
Fifth level of Qi refining!
Sixth level of Qi refining!
Seventh level of Qi refining!
The power of yin and yang condensed by these five thousand spirit stones instantly lifted him to three minor realms!
"What a heaven-defying power of yin and yang!"
Feeling his soaring cultivation level, Ye Changtian was also amazed in his heart.
His talent is so poor that he has pseudo-spiritual roots that are as useless as trash.
Even if he absorbs spiritual stones day and night to practice, the speed of his improvement is almost the same as a snail.
But the power of yin and yang condensed in the world of yin and yang creation perfectly matches the yin and yang creation art he practiced. Even if he is just a waste with pseudo-spiritual roots, he can instantly absorb it and transform it into his own cultivation.
That is to say.
From now on, he only needs to use spirit stones to gather the power of yin and yang in the yin and yang world of creation, and his cultivation level will continue to improve!
Who is still working hard to practice even though they all died?
Making money for krypton gold is the way to go!
When Ye Changtian used the power of yin and yang to improve his strength, Yue Qingshuang naturally felt the changes in Ye Changtian, and a look of astonishment flashed across his beautiful eyes.
Isn’t this guy a pseudo-spiritual person with extremely poor talent?
What on earth did he do to cause his cultivation to soar from the fourth level of Qi Refining to the seventh level of Qi Refining in an instant?
Instantly improve three small realms!
Even if she had the Tianling Root, it would be impossible for her to do it.
No wonder the master told her that having sex with this guyXiu can bring her back to the top.
This guy really has a big secret.
Just——
How can she successfully complete dual cultivation with Ye Changtian?
You can't just use force directly, right?
But dual cultivation is not just a simple one. If Ye Changtian is unwilling to cooperate, even if she uses force, it will have no effect.
"Why don't you give me some medicine first and then seduce me?"
Yue Qingshuang muttered secretly.
First, get some medicine to stimulate Ye Changtian's desire. She didn't believe that Ye Changtian could bear it based on her looks and figure!
"Junior Sister Qingshuang, what did you just say?"
At this moment, Ye Changtian also opened his eyes and looked towards Yue Qingshuang.
"No...nothing."
Yue Qingshuang was startled and shook her head quickly.
Ye Changtian stared at Yue Qingshuang for a long time, and then slowly said: "Junior Sister Qingshuang, I know you are definitely not just a new handyman disciple. Tell me, what is your purpose of approaching me?"
"I said I came to you to practice dual cultivation. Do you believe it?"
Yue Qingshuang blinked her big and lively eyes.
"???"
Ye Changtian's eyes suddenly widened and he looked at Yue Qingshuang in disbelief.
It seems he was right.
Is this woman really here to lust after his body?
"Let me introduce myself. My name is Yue Qingshuang. I am the former saint of Taixuan Sect. My master asked me to come to the Miscellaneous Peak to find you."
Yue Qingshuang did not hide anything and directly revealed her identity.
"You...are you the legendary Saint of the Sky and Moon?"
Ye Changtian looked at Yue Qingshuang in shock.
Saint of the Sky and Moon!
He was the first peerless genius in the history of Taixuanzong to possess the Heavenly Spiritual Root, and he was also the youngest in the history of Taixuanzong to reach the Golden Core Realm!
It's a pity——
However, due to an accident, this Heavenly Moon Saint had her foundation destroyed and all her cultivation lost, and she disappeared from the Taixuan Sect ever since.
Now this Heavenly Moon Saint appeared in front of him.
And she came to him for dual cultivation!
Could it be that after Xia Qiushui tried his Yin-Yang Creation Technique, he felt that the Yin-Yang Creation Technique could help Yue Qingshuang repair her foundation, so she asked Yue Qingshuang to come to him?
"Sage of Heaven and Moon, I'm afraid I may not have the ability to restore you."
Ye Changtian came back to his senses, shook his head and said.
"Master says you can do it, you can do it."
Yue Qingshuang glanced at Ye Changtian: "Why, you don't want to?"
"That's not true."
Ye Changtian smiled bitterly.
I just practiced dual cultivation with your master not long ago. If I practice dual cultivation with you now, wouldn’t my seniority be messed up in the future?
"Crack!"
Yue Qingshuang didn't waste any time and threw 10,000 spirit stones directly in front of Ye Changtian.
"Ten thousand spirit stones once, do it or not!"
"Do it, do it!"
Ye Changtian nodded repeatedly.
Do it once and get 10,000 spirit stones!
Even if he goes with something, he can't go with Lingshi.
After putting away the spirit stone, Ye Changtian quickly lay down on the bed.
"Lady Saint, I'm ready, come on."
